title: Resource envelope
description: The core's half of a Resource file (ADR 0128): id, Title, the id of a kind, and content the core does not read. It names no kind; resource.schema.json composes it with the kinds a build registers.

content.description: The kind's own content, parsed only by the kind's module.

id.description: A durable UUID. A Resource's identity is this field, never its file name.

title.description: One or more Title Lines separated by newlines; the first is the Resource's name. At least one line must have something in it. Intake normalizes it: CR and CRLF fold to LF, trailing whitespace on each line and leading and trailing blank lines are dropped, interior blank lines are kept (ADR 0083).

kind.description: Required (ADR 0128). A kind id: a built-in kind's bare id, or a vendor kind's vnd.<owner>.<name> (ADR 0120). A bare id and each of owner and name are ASCII letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit (ADR 0128), so a kind id never holds a dot outside the vnd. form, a slash or a parameter, and cannot be read as a media type. Whether the kind is registered is not the envelope's to say.
